description: Disconnect a sign-in based integration (for example Google Ads, Meta Ads or HubSpot) from a deployed agent. Call it without confirm first: it shows what is connected and what will be removed, and changes nothing. After the user agrees, call again with confirm: true. The saved sign-in, the selected accounts and the connection's settings are cleared (your own app keys are kept), the provider is asked to revoke the access where it supports that, scheduled tasks that need the integration stop running, and a running agent restarts. It cannot be undone; reconnect with connect_agent_oauth. For plain credentials such as Telegram, clear fields with set_agent_credentials instead.

agent_guid.description: The deployed agent's guid, from list_my_agents.

confirm.description: false (default) only shows what would be removed. true disconnects.

credential.description: The integration's credential key, for example "google-ads" or "meta-ads".

name: disconnect_agent_oauth
title: Disconnect an agent integration
